design_system.reasoning: A serious B2B sales-tech / telephony SaaS handling GDPR and UK cold-calling laws requires authority, clarity, and truth. The Swiss High-Contrast archetype ensures dense data is highly readable and compliance features feel trustworthy and objective.

layout.sidebar: w-64 flex-shrink-0 border-r border-border bg-surface flex flex-col
layout.grid_strategy: Control Room Grid - grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4

components.card: bg-surface border border-border p-5 rounded-sm shadow-sm
components.button: inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-sm text-sm font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2
components.input: flex h-10 w-full rounded-sm border border-border bg-transparent px-3 py-2 text-sm placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring
components.badge: inline-flex items-center rounded-none border px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-semibold transition-colors focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-ring focus:ring-offset-2
components.kanban_column: w-80 flex-shrink-0 flex flex-col gap-3 bg-accent/50 p-3 rounded-sm border border-border

accessibility.data_testid_requirement: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case, role-based.
accessibility.contrast: Minimum 4.5:1 for normal text, explicit text color definitions on all hover states.

media.icons: Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for sharp, technical dashboard clarity.

features: Live Call Feed / AI Calling Engine View
KPI widgets (Connect Rate, Opt-outs, Positive Responses)
dashboard.styling_notes: Dense metric cards. Use JetBrains Mono for numbers. Sharp geometric progress bars.

features: Lead Status Pipeline (New, Contacted, Positive, Callback, Opted-out, DNC)
Slide-out Contact Detail View with Call History
crm_leads.styling_notes: Use intense background hues for status indicators (e.g., solid signal red dot for Opted-out). Tabular data must be perfectly left-aligned.

campaigns.styling_notes: Voice selection cards should feature inline play/pause audio interaction. Script editor must use a monospace font to look like a raw input engine.

compliance_center.layout: Settings-style vertical lists with deep data logs
features: GDPR Consent & Right to Erasure actions
compliance_center.styling_notes: Extremely formal UI. Use a 'monochrome-first' approach, reserving red (#FF3B30) strictly for destructive actions (Erasure, DNC enforcement).

admin_settings.styling_notes: Clear, separated form segments for API keys with obscured inputs. Emphasize saved vs unsaved states.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use pure Shadcn UI but aggressively customize the border-radius to `rounded-sm` (2px-4px) and remove generic drop-shadows to fit the Swiss Brutalist aesthetic.
No teal, no purple. Stick exclusively to the designated color palette: White, Off-white, Klein Blue, Red, Yellow, Emerald.
Implement `data-testid` on ALL buttons, inputs, tabs, and list items (e.g., data-testid='create-campaign-button').
For the CRM, build a robust pure-Tailwind HTML table or customize Shadcn Table for maximum data density (py-2 padding on cells instead of standard py-4).
For Typography: use Cabinet Grotesk (or similar geometric bold sans) for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body/UI text.
